text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average ended a volatile session higher on Friday, as late program trading helped erase some of the previous day's 160-point loss.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow index closed up 56.57 points, or 0.82 percent, at 6,935.46. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by 14 to 10 on active volume of 489 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Dow fell more than 160 points on Thursday after robust February retail sales data rekindled fears that the Federal Reserve might raise interest rates soon.
